brief.objective: Minimize closest Lady distance squared plus 1e6/(closest Guard distance+0.1). The Lady term dominates: starting 2600 m out costs about 6.8e6, while a Guard pass at 100 m costs only about 1e4. Close most of the 2600 m within 240 s without letting the Guard reach 5 m, because a capture ends the episode and freezes the Lady miss distance.
brief.approach: Accelerate early and hard toward the Lady (+y) at up to 15 m/s, using a radial offset waypoint of about 300 to 400 m to sidestep the Guard rather than flying straight through it. Re-aim continuously, since the advanced Guard re-aims and closes at about 12 m/s. Trigger EVADE_GUARD only when the Guard is inside the keepout and closing, sidestepping radially around it and toward the Lady, then return immediately to APPROACH_LADY once the Guard is behind or abeam. Accept Guard passes near 100 m, but never allow its distance below about 30 m; inside about 400 m of the Lady, brake onto the glide slope for a slow final approach to under 5 m while keeping enough fuel for one late evasion.
phases: 0-20 s: burn along-track toward the Lady to reach 12-15 m/s while drifting radially to a 300-400 m offset waypoint, opening a lane past the Guard
20-140 s: run past the Guard at high closing speed; EVADE_GUARD sidesteps when the Guard is inside 150 m and closing, then resume APPROACH_LADY at once
140-200 s: once the Guard is behind, brake progressively along the glide slope to cut closing speed below 5 m/s inside 400 m of the Lady
200-240 s: final APPROACH_LADY at about 2.5 m/s to get within 5 m; if the Guard re-closes inside 50 m, take a short evade and then continue toward the Lady
